info.name: ElectricalStore API
info.description:
Executable API contract for ElectricalStore (frozen backend).

**Suggested Storefront sequence:** Catalog categories → products → product detail → shipping zones → checkout preview → Place guest order → guest track → Login → my orders.

**Suggested Back Office sequence:** Login → categories → product+variants → media → inventory adjust → shipping zone → ordering settings → orders lifecycle → Access Management.

**Auth:** Collection Bearer uses `{{accessToken}}`. Public folders/requests set noauth.

**Idempotency:** Set/reuse `idempotencyKey` for Place Order retries; replace for a new order. Pre-request initializes only when empty.

**Guest:** `X-Order-Token: {{guestOrderToken}}` — never commit real tokens.

Aligned to current Minimal API endpoints / Swagger tags. No invented deferred routes.

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Register a new customer. Expected: 201. Sample password is a local placeholder only — replace in your private environment; never use production passwords.

Login. Expected: 200 with `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `userId` (or MFA payload if enabled). 401 invalid credentials. Rate-limited (`Login`). Test script stores tokens into the active environment (never console.log).
Rotate access token. Expected: 200. Test script updates `accessToken` / `refreshToken`.

item.description: Permixa auth surface. Public. Set `ownerEmail` / `ownerPassword` locally in the environment (never commit real values).

request.description: Current user id + effective permission names. Expected: 200. 401 without Bearer.
Storefront catalog. Active categories only. Expected: 200. Script captures first `categoryId` when present.
Catalog-ready products only. Expected: 200. Script may capture `productId` / first `variantId`.
Product detail with variants/images. Expected: 200. 404 if not catalog-ready.
Public active zones for checkout. Expected: 200. Script captures first `deliveryZoneId`.
Non-persisting totals from current catalog/stock/shipping. Never trusts client money fields. Expected: 200. 400 validation. May fail minimum order / stock rules as ProblemDetails.

item.name: Orders
Guest

header.description: Generate once per checkout attempt; reuse on retry; replace for a new order.

request.description: Guest Place Order. Requires `Idempotency-Key` (16–128 chars, high-entropy). Does **not** reserve inventory. Expected: 201 Created. Returns `guestAccessToken` once — script stores as `guestOrderToken` (never log). 409 concurrency; 400 below minimum / validation. Idempotent replay returns the same order + token.

exec: // Initialize once per checkout attempt. Reuse on retries; clear/replace for a new order.

request.description: Guest tracking. Requires `X-Order-Token`. Expected: 200. Invalid/mismatched token → 404 (ownership hiding) or 400 missing token.
Modify PendingConfirmation only; reprices. Expected: 200. 404 ownership hiding. 409 concurrency.
Cancel own PendingConfirmation. Expected: 200. 404 ownership hiding. 409 invalid transition.

item.description: Guest order access via `X-Order-Token: {{guestOrderToken}}`. Never put a real token in examples.

request.description: Same Place Order contract with Bearer. Guest token usually null. Clear `idempotencyKey` before a new attempt. Expected: 201.

Own order only. Expected: 200. 404 if not owned.

item.name: Back Office - Orders

request.description: Atomic reserve. Requires Orders.Manage. Expected: 200. 409 insufficient stock / concurrency / invalid transition.
COD only when OutForDelivery or Delivered. Expected: 200. 409 already paid / invalid transition.
Reason required. Releases reservation when Confirmed/Preparing. Expected: 200. 409.

item.description: Orders.Read / Orders.Manage. Lifecycle: Confirm → Prepare → OutForDelivery → Deliver; MarkPaid when allowed.

item.name: Back Office - Access Management

request.description: Iam.Users.Read. Hierarchically manageable users only (Owner typically excluded). Expected: 200. 403 hierarchy.
Effective permissions with source provenance. Self → CannotManageSelf. Expected: 200. 403/404.
Iam.Roles.Read. Manageable + actor's own (Owner reference). Saves roleId/referenceRoleId.
Iam.Roles.Create. Placement: Above|Below|SameLevel. Expected: 201. Saves roleId.
Iam.Roles.Delete when Permixa allows (no users/permissions; Owner protected). Expected: 204.
Iam.Permissions.Read. Grouped by name prefix. Saves first permissionId.
Iam.Audit.Read. Permixa durable IAM audit. Expected: 200.

item.description: Thin `/admin/access` adapters over Permixa. No deferred user create/lock/session routes. RoleLevel: lower int = higher authority.
